title: Umbral Manipulations
subtitle: Tenebris — blood remembers shadow
text: Umbral blood has absorbed long hours in darkness — caves, long nights, the specific quality of shadow that lies behind things. Void Shroud (QUICK, ?): bend light around the blood in your skin, becoming invisible for several seconds. Any aggressive act dispels the shroud. Umbral Step (QUICK, 300): compress your body through shadow, teleporting a short distance in the direction you are looking. Blood Eclipse (QUICK, ?): flood an area with blood-shadow, blinding every target within range and disorienting them. Tenebris rewards patience and positioning.
